summary: Iteration 41 — v1.17.0 light-mode polish trilogy (Studio eyebrow + Owner pill + Settings/Keys page) verified GREEN. All 9 acceptance criteria PASS via getComputedStyle inspection in real browser. Dark-mode regression byte-for-byte unchanged. v1.16.0 Thumbnails light fixes still working. No new bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: Clean v1.17.0 scope — overrides are all inside [data-theme='light'] block, routed through design tokens (var(--surface), var(--bg), var(--muted), var(--warning), var(--accent), var(--border)). Dark mode is provably untouched (rgb(201,149,108) eyebrow, rgba(15,10,30,0.55) card bg both verified pixel-exact).

App.css is now well past 6800+ lines. Recommend per-page CSS modules (studio.css, thumbnails.css, settings.css) each owning its own [data-theme='light'] block. Otherwise the trilogy will become a quadrilogy when the next card component (e.g., /admin tabs, /resources tiles) lands.

Consider introducing a shared `.surface-card` mixin/utility (bg=var(--surface), border=1px solid var(--border), shadow=var(--shadow-card)) so future card components automatically theme-switch and avoid the recurring pattern of hardcoded rgba(15,10,30,0.55) leaking into light mode.

Owner pill light-mode gradient (cream→lavender) is subtle but legible against the lavender page bg. Border rgb(168,112,69) at 1px is what carries the visual weight — good call. Make sure new pills follow the same border+gradient pattern rather than relying on the dark 16% alpha trick.
seed_data_creation: Used live Anthropic key save+delete cycle on the actual /settings/keys page (sk-ant-test1234 placeholder, deleted at end — no residue).

rca of the issue: Iter_40 left .settings-key-card + studio/thumbs eyebrow + .quota-pill-unlimited still authored against dark palette only (hardcoded rgba(15,10,30,0.55) and copper #c9956c). v1.17.0 fix adds a comprehensive [data-theme='light'] block (App.css L6735-6870) that re-points every affected element to design tokens — eyebrow color shifts from the original rgb(201,149,108) (which washed out on lavender) to a 78%-warning + 22%-black mix landing at rgb(131,87,54) which holds 4.5:1+ contrast against the lavender page bg. Settings cards route through var(--surface)=white. Save buttons use var(--warning) as primary CTA (Stripe-style copper-on-white). Dark mode is provably unchanged because every override is gated on the [data-theme='light'] selector.
